text:
[issue by UnknownSerhan]
Same issue as https://github.com/GlodBlock/ExtendedAE/issues/233, I can easily reproduce the issue by doing nothing extraordinary. I am just sending water to the interface and it accepts all of it. I can also configure the interface to store max integer value of fluids. This issue doesn't happen with any other interface, only oversized one. ExtendedAE config is untouched (the oversized interface multiplier is x16)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/60747fb9-bd44-481d-9aaa-0ecc8a542f25)

NeoForge: 21.1.42
ExtendedAE: 1.21-2.0.3

Here is a forced crash for more info: https://gist.github.com/UnknownSerhan/c0804c6decc187398a01522cdc0a84f3
